items.response: CHECK 4 QT MIN, 9 QT FOR EXT FLIGHTS

items.detail: Hold for 20 seconds, verify that green test lamp does not go out, then ARM (verify that PFD comes on).

items.response: RICH UNTIL STEADY FLOW, THEN CUT-OFF
ADVANCE TO FULL RICH WHEN ENGINE STARTS

items.text: If the engine floods, place the mixture control in the Idle Cut Off position, open the throttle control ½ to full, and engage the starter motor (Start). When the engine starts, advance the mixture control to the Full Rich position and retard the throttle control promptly.
Check MFD for correct A/C type and Jeppesen expiration dates, then press ENT

items.detail: RPM drop 175 or 50 differential between magnetos.
Above 5000 ft. alt., lean for max. RPM.
Above 5000 ft. alt., lean for max. RPM.

items.response: BOTH (OR START IF PROPELLER IS STOPPED)

items.text: If propeller is windmilling, engine will restart automatically within a few seconds. If propeller has stopped (possible at low speeds), turn Magnetos switch to Start, advance throttle slowly from idle, and lean the mixture from full rich, as required to obtain smooth operation.
If the indicated fuel flow (FFLOW GPH) immediately drops to zero, a sign of failure of the engine-driven fuel pump, return the Fuel Pump switch to the On Position.

items.detail: Note terrain and obstructions, then retract flaps upon reaching a safe altitude and airspeed.

items.text: If no power is available, approach at 70 KIAS with flaps up or at 65 KIAS with 10º of Flaps.

items.response: CUSHION AT TOUCHDOWN WITH FOLDED COAT

items.text: If necessary, open window and flood cabin to equalize pressure so doors can be opened

items.response: SHUT DOWN AND INSPECT FOR DAMAGE

items.detail: Use fire extinguisher, wool blanket, or dirt.

items.response: PUSH DOWN AND ROTATE TO OFF

items.detail: If fire is not extinguished, increase glide speed to find an airspeed, within airspeed limitations, which will provide an incombustible mixture.

items.text: Refer to Emergency Landing Without Power
If fire has been extinguished and electrical power is necessary for continued flight to nearest suitable airport or landing area

items.response: AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO INSPECT FOR DAMAGE

items.text: Perform a sideslip to keep the flames away from the fuel tank and cabin. Land as soon as possible using flaps only as required for final approach and touchdown.

items.text: If Vacuum Pointer Is Out Of The Green ARC During Flight Or The Gyro Flag Is Shown On The Standby Attitude Indicator, The Standby Attitude Indicator Must Not Be Used For Attitude Information.
